(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix Notification Center Global Router. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/notification-center/routing/introduction/.
create_time  tftypes.String computed
    description: The create time. Set by the server; a value sent by the client is ignored.
description  tftypes.String computed
    description: Description of the GlobalRouter.
disabled  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Disables the router without deleting it. Defaults to false.
entity_labels  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
fallback  nested LIST computed
    description: Fallback routing targets. Removing the block clears them.
fallback.connector_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: ID of the connector.
fallback.custom_details  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Custom details for the target.
fallback.preset_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: ID of the preset.
fallback_targets  nested LIST computed
    description: Per-entity-type fallback targets used when no routing rule matches. Replaces the deprecated `fallback`. Omit the block to clear the fallback targets.
fallback_targets.entity_type  tftypes.String computed
    description: The entity type this fallback applies to.
fallback_targets.target  nested SINGLE computed
    description: The fallback routing target.
fallback_targets.target.connector_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: ID of the connector.
fallback_targets.target.custom_details  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Custom details for the target.
fallback_targets.target.preset_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: ID of the preset.
id  tftypes.String optional
    description: The ID of the GlobalRouter. Use `router_default` for the default; leave empty for auto generated or provide your own (unique) id.
name  tftypes.String optional,computed
    description: Name of the GlobalRouter.
routing_labels  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Routers other than `router_default` require at least one of the properties to be set. Note that these values are globally unique. Labels matching is linked with AND, so an alert has to have all labels specified below.
routing_labels.environment  tftypes.String computed
routing_labels.service  tftypes.String computed
routing_labels.team  tftypes.String computed
rules  nested LIST computed
    description: Routing rules for the GlobalRouter.
rules.condition  tftypes.String computed
rules.custom_details  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Custom details for the rule.
rules.entity_type  tftypes.String computed
rules.name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Name of the routing rule.
rules.targets  nested LIST computed
    description: Routing targets for the rule.
rules.targets.connector_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: ID of the connector.
rules.targets.custom_details  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Custom details for the target.
rules.targets.preset_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: ID of the preset.
update_time  tftypes.String computed
    description: Timestamp of the last update. Set by the server; a value sent by the client is ignored.
